svg.aria-label: The PDSA graph as a constellation: 108 nodes and 133 edges, 22 cycles chained by NEXT with 5 REINFORCES arcs looping back
svg.text: The loop’s compounding becomes a constellation
108 nodes · 133 edges · read from the project’s own graph memory (pdsa view renders the same data)
Every cycle carries its four phases; NEXT chains them in time; REINFORCES loops back to what was left unproven.
